events.text: Ehrensvärd became acting sub-lieutenant (underlöjtnant) in the Swedish Navy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He became acting sub-lieutenant ( underlöjtnant ) in the Swedish Navy in 1878

events.text: Ehrensvärd was promoted to lieutenant commander.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Ehrensvärd was promoted to lieutenant commander in 1900

events.text: Ehrensvärd became head of the Military Office of the Ministry for Naval Affairs.
events.subject: self
events.object: Military Office of the Ministry for Naval Affairs
events.quote: He was head of the Military Office of the Ministry for Naval Affairs from 1904 to 1906

events.text: Ehrensvärd's headship of the Military Office of the Ministry for Naval Affairs ended.
events.subject: self
events.object: Military Office of the Ministry for Naval Affairs

events.subject: self
events.quote: he was promoted to captain in 1905

events.text: Ehrensvärd was chief of the shipyard in Karlskrona.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Ehrensvärd was chief of the shipyard in Karlskrona in 1906

events.text: Ehrensvärd became Council of State (statsråd) and head of the Ministry for Naval Affairs.
events.subject: self
events.quote: has been Council of State ( statsråd ) and head of the Ministry for Naval Affairs since 4 December 1907

events.text: Ehrensvärd was promoted to rear admiral.
events.subject: self

events.text: Ehrensvärd was appointed station commander in Stockholm.
events.subject: self

events.text: Ehrensvärd was appointed Inspector of the Navys Exercises at Sea.
events.subject: self
events.object: Inspector of the Navys Exercises at Sea
events.quote: In 1916 he was appointed Inspector of the Navys Exercises at Sea

events.text: Ehrensvärd was promoted to vice admiral.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the year after Ehrensvärd was promoted to vice admiral

events.text: Ehrensvärd was appointed Highest Commander of the Coastal Fleet.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1919 Ehrensvärd was appointed Highest Commander of the Coastal Fleet

events.text: Ehrensvärd became commanding admiral and station commander in Karlskrona.
events.subject: self
events.quote: commanding admiral and station commander in Karlskrona from 1919 to 1923

events.text: Ehrensvärd's command as commanding admiral and station commander in Karlskrona ended.
events.subject: self

events.text: Ehrensvärd was appointed chief of His Majestys Military Staff.
events.subject: self
events.quote: appointed chief of His Majestys Military Staff in 1924

events.text: Ehrensvärd was promoted to full admiral.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Ehrensvärd was promoted to full admiral in 1926
